The changes are consistent and well-reasoned. The root cause of the flaky test (issue #112439) was that `randomIntBetween(0, 20)` could produce a count of `0`, meaning no doubles were added in the "different values" section, leaving `stats1` and `stats2` still equal and causing the `not(equalTo(...))` assertion to fail. Changing the lower bound to `1` guarantees at least one independently-generated double is added to each accumulator, making the inequality assertion reliable. Raising the upper bound to `1000` adds more variation at negligible cost. Removing the entry from `muted-tests.yml` is the correct companion change to re-enable the now-stable test.
No issues identified.

Also, I did run the tests with `-D tests.iters=1000000` to check the randomization
